Description
The
South African Krugerrand Gold Coins
are the most widely owned bullion gold coin globally. The purpose of the original issue was to encourage individual ownership of the gold and it was said the krugerrand golds clearly met the objective.
The 1/10 oz krugerrand gold coin
– South African is available in Brilliant Uncirculated conditions from the years of our choice.
The Krugerrand is Africa’s premium gold bullion coins and was first released in 1967. While there are other coins minted on behalf of the African government throughout the continent, Krugerrand is one of the few gold coins produced within an African country.
Kruger’s name was combined with the word “rand,” which refers to a South African currency. It doesn’t get any purer than a genuine Krugerrand in terms of purity.
The South African 1/10 oz Gold Krugerrand Coin is made of 22 karat gold (91 percent pure), with copper making up the rest of the weight. Copper is extremely hardy and gives the Krugerrand an orange tint, similar to crown gold. Each of the Gold Coins has been minted 1/10 troy oz of pure gold. The year of mintage may vary depending on the availability of the coin in our inventory.
Design of South African Coin – 1/10 oz Gold Krugerrands
The design of these gold coins is well recognized all over the world hence they are easy to trade and liquidate. The 1/10 South African Krugerrand Gold Coin features artwork that offers an exciting tribute to both the heritage and culture of South Africa. The portrait of
Paul Krugger
, South Africa’s first and only president, along with “South Africa” in Afrikaans and English is depicted on the obverse of the gold coin. From his penetrating eyes to his signature long beard, the artist Otto Schultz has made certain to carefully render every detail of this historical figure so as to provide an accurate portrayal.
The reverse side of the South African 1/10 oz Gold Krugerrand Coin(Random Year) features South Africa’s most iconic creature, the  Springbok antelope created by Coert Steynberg. The year of minting and Gold weight is also depicted on the reverse side of the coin

Start A Collection Of Precious Metals Coins Featuring Antelopes With 1/10 oz Gold Krugerrands
The springbok antelope portrayed on gold Krugerrands is one of the most famous figures depicted on any gold currency, maybe more so than on any other coin featuring antelope iconography. In addition to these 1/10 oz gold coins, Bullion Trading LLC offers the Bavarian State Mint’s 1 Oz Silver Coin-Elephant coins, known as the African Wildlife Series Elephant Coins, which make excellent companion pieces to Krugerrands. Along with South African Krugerrands Gold, these other elephant-themed coins are both visually appealing and have the potential to form a powerful collection.
Purchase 1/10 oz Gold Krugerrands To Diversify Your Investment Portfolio
Many investors prefer 1/10 oz Gold Krugerrands because they are recognized to offer balance to an investing portfolio. Because 1/10 oz gold coins, like many other gold coins, are frequently held for longer than three years, gold’s past performance becomes more relevant than its current price. While the value of fractional gold Krugerrands and other gold bullion may fluctuate, gold generally moves independently of the stock market. Many people believe that South African gold is a good investment among precious metals because of its minimal correlation with other assets.
